content:
“Lumberjack Protectron does not want to lose lumberjack job to cheap human labor.”— Lumberjack Protectron

**Gilman Lumber Mill** is a location in The Forest region of Appalachia. As of the *Atlantic City Boardwalk Paradise* update, it is a Responders base.

Several Responders members inhabit the main building, where June Seaver serves as a vendor.

“Two dilapidated warehouses still stand in this overgrown lumberyard, tended by a nearby (relatively friendly) robots. Come here for the initial scavenging opportunities.”— Atlas of Appalachia

The layout of the lumber mill is a large fenced off rectangular area. Inside this area is a half-destroyed main building, which contains a Stash Box, Armor Workbench, Weapons Workbench, Punch Card Machine, Ammunition Vending Machine, and Medical Supplies Vending Machine - all of which are located on the first floor. Toward the back of the building are a Tinker's Workbench, Power Armor Station, and Cooking Station.

Next to the main building is a warehouse filled with log piles and Wood Scraps. Speaking to the Lumberjack Protectrons will result in the robots providing 10 Wood Scraps to the Vault Dwellers.

- A Job Opportunity - Note, in the main building, on a crate on an exterior catwalk on the second floor.
- To Addie - Note, on a table to the right of the Punch Card Machine.
- Quartermaster's Report - Note, in the main building, on a wooden crate left of June Seaver.

Gilman Lumber Mill appears in *Fallout 76*.

- Post-Atlantic City

- Stash Box and Gurneys
- Weapons Workbench and Punch Card Machine
- Cooking Station, Power Armor Station, Tinker's Workbench
- Armor Workbench
